newsitem.title: USA: IVI content to appear on Time Warner site.
newsitem.headline: IVI content to appear on Time Warner site.

text.p: IVI Publishing Inc said Tuesday it agreed to allow Time Warner's new Road Runner on-line cable service to display its digital health and medical content.
Under the agreement, Time Warner Cable secured the non-exclusive rights to offer Road Runner customers access to a digital version of The Medical Advisor, an IVI medical guidebook.
IVI's content will form part of Road Runner's "Around the Home" section.

The agreement with Time Warner was announced a month after AT&T said it was discontinuing its HealthSite on the Internet. IVI had maintained health and medical content pages in a beta test of HealthSite.
